summary.headline: Bologna Codex: Magic and Medicine
summary.text: Catalog entry for a Bologna codex describing painted images of the astronomer Heracles and disciple, lunar astronomical tables and eclipses, lecanomancy and catoptromancy with Persian practitioners Apollonios and Symonedes, cryptographic alphabets and notes, chronology, brontologion, talismanic magic, lexica, medicinal remedies, and herbs associated with the twelve zodiac signs and seven planets. It cites Bouché-Leclercq, Olivieri, Pitra, and a Venetian codex, and includes astronomical computations for 1441–1447.
